restrictions.tos_notes: Public Job Board API (no authentication for GET endpoints). Applications go through the hosted form in the browser; the application API needs an employer key.
Public Postings API (api.lever.co, EU: api.eu.lever.co). Applications go through the browser form at jobs.lever.co; the apply API needs a key.
Public Job Posting API. Postings with isListed=false are skipped. Applications go through the browser form at jobs.ashbyhq.com.
Keyless access to the Posting API is best-effort; the source stops on the first 401/403.
Uses Workable's undocumented widget endpoint, which may change without notice; a schema mismatch stops the source.
Undocumented, often bot-protected endpoint. Opt in per tenant; one request at a time with at least 3 s between requests. The tenant is disabled on the first denial or challenge.
Static careers page: JSON-LD JobPosting first, then configured selectors. A link to a known ATS host is redirected to that ATS adapter.
Crawls one site (allowed_domains = its host) from a start URL, at most 50 pages; uses the sitemap when present.
Fetches one job URL (JSON-LD, then OpenGraph, then page heuristics). Pages fetched with your own browser session are stored as private postings.

adapters.reason: LinkedIn's robots.txt and User Agreement (§8.2) prohibit scraping and automated access. Track LinkedIn jobs manually by title and company.
Indeed's terms (§21, Job Seekers §3) prohibit automated access and automated job applications. Track Indeed jobs manually by title and company.
